Deep in {wiki:Demona|Demona}, full of {creature:Warlock|Warlocks} and {creature:Elf Arcanist|Elf Arcanists}, there is a bookshelf room where two maps and a rare book are hidden. Make your way to Demona, find the bookshelf room and search the shelves for the {item:Tibia Map (Book)|Tibia Map}, the {item:Fields of Glory Map (Book)|Fields of Glory Map} and the {item:Purple Tome}.
Go to the cave south of Northport
Open the hole with the shovel
Use the {item:Shovel} at this spot to dig a hole and go in.
Follow the **blue line** on the map to the next hole.
Route to the next hole (blue line)

Keep following the blue line until you find a small grove inside the cave. At the **red** spot, behind the trees, there is a hole: go down and flip the lever inside to the **right** to open the MoLS entrance. Then leave the hole.
Red spot: hole with the lever, behind the trees
If the lever is already flipped to the right, flip it to the left and then to the right again.
Follow this path to the entrance of the Maze of Lost Souls. You will have to cross some {item:Energy Field|Energy Fields}.
Energy Fields drain your health when you cross them: go through with full health.

Inside the MoLS, follow the map step by step. In the first entrance room is the {wiki:Griffin Shield Quest|Griffin Shield Quest}. Keep going to the end of the passage and cross the level 60 **Gate of Expertise**.
Stay on the path: off it there are {creature:Dragon|Dragons}, {creature:Dragon Lord|Dragon Lords} and {creature:Giant Spider|Giant Spiders}.
